scope: Synchronize existing local changes and explicitly approved delivery artifacts to the existing private repository. No ModelScope deployment, production-database mutation, or new model request.

python_all.failure_scope: Existing optional Lean integration: direct_sorry, indirect_sorry, direct_axiom and nat_add_zero; includes wall_timeout. No failing test was removed or weakened.

lean_separate_recheck.limitation: A separate passing run does not resolve intermittent Lean reliability or replace the first full-suite failure.

cloud_backend.command: python -X utf8 -B -m unittest discover -s deploy/modelscope/tests -p test_*.py

runtime_completeness.scope: Read-only dependency and required-file checks; no research database or model request.

excluded_local_material: Model API keys, environment secrets and platform credential screenshots
Production research databases and private user projects
Virtual environments, caches, temporary services and raw recording attempts
scientific_scope: The public cases retain actual source positions, nine real Qwen calls and the recorded human decision. Only six smoke configurations and an auxiliary diagnostic were executed; the formal 90-configuration protocol is still a plan. Structural tests and file hashes do not certify scientific conclusions.
